tasks.label: Setup: 初回セットアップ(.env + JWT鍵)
tasks.command: cp .env.example .env && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}/expense-saas/keys:/keys" alpine/openssl genrsa -out /keys/private.pem 2048 && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}/expense-saas/keys:/keys" alpine/openssl rsa -in /keys/private.pem -pubout -out /keys/public.pem

tasks.label: Docker: 起動 + ブラウザ
Docker: フルリセット + seed + ブラウザ(シークレット)
dependsOn: ブラウザ起動(シークレット)

tasks.label: ブラウザ起動(シークレット)
BE: lint
tasks.command: docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps test-be sh -c 'golangci-lint run ./... > /test-results/lint.txt 2>&1; cat /test-results/lint.txt'

tasks.label: BE: unit test
tasks.command: docker compose --profile test run --rm --no-deps test-be sh -c 'go test -p 1 ./... > /test-results/unit.txt 2>&1; cat /test-results/unit.txt'

tasks.label: BE: integration test
tasks.command: docker compose --profile test run --rm test-be sh -c 'go test -tags integration -p 1 ./... > /test-results/integration.txt 2>&1; cat /test-results/integration.txt'

tasks.label: BE: full test (lint + unit + integration)
tasks.command: docker compose --profile test run --rm test-be sh -c 'golangci-lint run ./... > /test-results/lint.txt 2>&1; go test -p 1 ./... > /test-results/unit.txt 2>&1; go test -tags integration -p 1 ./... > /test-results/integration.txt 2>&1; echo "--- lint.txt ---"; cat /test-results/lint.txt; echo "--- unit.txt ---"; cat /test-results/unit.txt; echo "--- integration.txt ---"; cat /test-results/integration.txt'
